configurations.name: expo-web-fx
configurations.description: Mobile web on a side port for FX QA

configurations.name: mobile-staging
configurations.description: Expo web against STAGING. -c clears the cache: EXPO_PUBLIC_* is baked into the bundle, so without it a running Metro keeps serving the previous environment.

configurations.name: web-worktree
configurations.description: Same app on a side port so a worktree can be verified without stopping the main checkout's :3000 server.

configurations.name: admin-worktree
configurations.description: Same admin console on a side port so a worktree can be verified without stopping the main checkout's :3001 server.

configurations.name: web-worktree-direct
configurations.description: Worktree frontend-web on :3010, invoking next directly (npm run dev -- --port exits immediately here).

configurations.name: backend-worktree
configurations.description: Go backend on :8092 — the binary has no godotenv autoload, so .env must be shell-sourced before `go run`; this worktree's .env sets APP_PORT=8092 so it doesn't collide with the main checkout's :8091.

configurations.name: backend-auth-uat
runtimeArgs: set -a; . ./.env; set +a; APP_PORT=8114 exec go run ./cmd/server
configurations.description: Throwaway Go backend on :8114 for AUTH-020 STEM Overview UAT verification, so it doesn't collide with other worktrees on :8091/:8092/.../:8113.

configurations.name: admin-auth-uat
configurations.description: Throwaway admin console on :3024 pointed at backend-auth-uat (:8114), for AUTH-020 STEM Overview UAT verification.

configurations.name: admin-food005-uat
configurations.description: Throwaway admin console on :3025 pointed at the FOOD-005 throwaway backend (:8096), for live withdrawals-page verification without touching the shared :8091/:3001.

configurations.name: admin-property-uat
runtimeArgs: ADMIN_API_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8130 NEXT_PUBLIC_PROPERTY_ADMIN_USE_MOCK=false exec npx next dev --port 3026
configurations.description: Throwaway admin console on :3026 pointed at a throwaway Go backend on :8130 (FEATURE_PROPERTY_SUITE_ENABLED=true), for PROPMGMT-003 rent-passport admin UI live verification without touching the shared :8091/:3001.

configurations.name: backend-estate-uat
runtimeArgs: set -a; . ./.env; set +a; APP_PORT=8140 FEATURE_ESTATE_ENABLED=true exec go run ./cmd/server
configurations.description: Throwaway Go backend on :8140 (FEATURE_ESTATE_ENABLED=true) for the estate admin-console UAT batch, so it doesn't collide with other worktrees on :8091/:8092/.../:8130.

configurations.name: admin-estate-uat
runtimeArgs: ADMIN_API_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8140 NEXT_PUBLIC_ESTATE_ADMIN_USE_MOCK=false exec npx next dev --port 3027
configurations.description: Throwaway admin console on :3027 pointed at backend-estate-uat (:8140), for the estate admin-console UAT batch live verification without touching the shared :8091/:3001.

configurations.name: mobile-worktree
configurations.description: Expo web on :8086 for this worktree, cache-cleared so EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL=:3010 / EXPO_PUBLIC_MARKETPLACE_USE_MOCK=false actually take effect.
